note: Do not submit under the exact name Zenith or Zenit. Those collide with live Finance apps. Pick a unique public name first, then paste this into App Store Connect.
description:
INR personal finance that stays on this device. See what is left to spend this month, log cash and UPI-style spends, set category budgets, track recurring bills, savings goals, and a travel trip in local currency.

No bank login. No SMS scrape. Export CSV or a JSON backup anytime.

Travel Mode tracks a trip budget separately from home spend. One demo trip is free.

Hindi and English.
promotionalText: Your leftover rupees, on this phone.
whatsNew: First TestFlight: local ledger, travel demo, Hindi + English.
reviewNotes: All data is localStorage on device. Create an expense with + then Manual. Travel is on Home (Travel card) or Plan. Unlock Pro is a local flag until IAP ships; it is not required to review the free demo trip.
